front.title: Discovery of LLM API Services in Local Networks

abstract.t:
Large Language Model (LLM) API services can be hosted on workstations, local servers, and other devices in a local network. AI applications commonly access these services through manually configured API base URLs and interface settings. When an application joins a different network or a service address changes, these settings may need to be updated even when a suitable local service is already available.
This document specifies a DNS-Based Service Discovery (DNS-SD) profile for discovering LLM API services on a local link. An advertiser publishes the service location and a small set of API connection parameters. A discovery client resolves these records and offers the resulting connection information to an AI application or its configuration adapter. Subsequent LLM API requests are sent directly to the discovered service, not through the advertiser or discovery client. Discovery does not establish trust, distribute credentials, select models, or define an application's configuration file format.
